description: Defines the customer playbook section hierarchy for an IQPlaybook item.

$schema.description: Identifies the schema version used by this playbook definition.

sections.description: The unique root-relative section paths in the customer playbook. An empty array represents a playbook with no sections. Every ancestor path must also be listed; the application must enforce this relationship because JSON Schema cannot validate arbitrary parent-path membership.

items.description: A literal, non-empty section path. A slash separates parent and child section names; leading slashes, trailing slashes, and empty path segments are not allowed. Section names have no additional character or length restrictions.
